place.title: Place {ref} (DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 4 legs into column f, one leg per row, with its grid facing you: VCC into hole {hole.vcc}, DATA into {hole.data}, NC into {hole.nc} and GND into {hole.gnd}.
place.tip: Looking at the grid, the legs are VCC, DATA, NC, GND from left to right. NC isn't connected inside the sensor, so it gets no wire.

why: {ref} measures the air's temperature (0 to 50 °C) and humidity (20 to 90 %) and sends both to the Pico as short pulses on one wire, its DATA leg.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND leg to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref} with 3.3 V. The pull-up resistor in this row gets 3.3 V too, so the data line rests at 3.3 V, the Pico's own level.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}'s data. To ask for a reading the Pico pulls this line low for a moment; the sensor then answers with 40 short pulses.
